lines.zh: 我挂在这里,风一吹就摇
lines.en: I hang here, swaying in the wind.
Silk holds me under the stem.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，没有腿可走。
lines.en: This body of mine has no legs to walk with.
I can only sway with the leaf.
The leaf moves, and so do I.
I do not walk; the wind moves me.
I wait for my body to finish changing.
The silk draws tighter.

lines.zh: 我在叶背上轻轻转了一点
lines.en: I rotate a fraction on the leaf.
Sounds from outside are muffled.
Something inside me is pushing.
One breath takes a long time.
My case is harder than yesterday.
One seam of the case is thinning.
I count the days one by one.
Soon, though not soon enough.
I hang completely still.
The silk is all I cling to.
I can hear water in the veins.

lines.zh: 壳内的身体在缓慢流动
lines.en: My body flows slowly inside.
Something is crawling outside.
Sunlight filters through the leaf.
I pack myself in tightly.

lines.zh: 翅膀的形状在里面成形
lines.en: Wings are taking shape within.
I dare not move; moving means falling.
Another day has passed.
My weight feels different.
I must wait a while longer.
You cannot see what I am becoming.

lines.zh: 现在是拨动我的好时机
lines.en: Now is a good time to touch me.
I am no longer a worm inside.
Come closer if you want a look.
I am hanging beneath a leaf.
Touch me and I fall.
My case is translucent.

lines.zh: 你能看见里面的暗影吗
lines.en: Can you see the shape inside?
This stage of mine has passed.
Don't touch the silk I'm hanging by.
My case has been pressed.
The silk has slipped a coil.
I cannot stop swaying.
I tighten all at once inside.

lines.zh: 这具身体连躲都躲不了
lines.en: This body cannot even dodge.
My shell is hard as a piece of wood.
A fine crack runs in my case.
I wait for it to pass.
Do not make me fall.
I am still hanging on the leaf.
In this shape I can't eat.
Right now I am only waiting.

lines.zh: 叶子离我很近,但我用不上
lines.en: The leaf is near, but of no use.
You shook the leaf.
That sway was nothing.
Something inside me stirred.
It must wait until the wings are done.

lines.zh: 我不需要你喂，丝里的养分够了。
lines.en: I need no feeding; the silk holds enough.
Touch again, and the silk slips.
All I need is time.
You touched the leaf.
I swing back and forth from the hit.
The silk is at its limit.
I press my case to the leaf.
I nearly fell.
My case is hard; it does not break.
The jolt leaves me dizzy inside.
Do not shake this tree.
I have steadied myself.
Be gentler next time.
I cannot answer you.

lines.zh: 这一阶段我什么都做不了
lines.en: At this stage I can do nothing.
You hang on the leaf beside me.
Two chrysalides sway together.
I feel your weight nearby.
Wait for the day we emerge.
Then we will fly.
For now, each of us waits.
Do not rush; there is time enough.
Hang right here.
I cannot move a step.
The silk holds me fast.
That touched my case.
I was swayed once.
It is caught in my silk.
I hang under the branch, waiting to emerge.
Take it away.
It blocks my light.
I only need not to be bumped.
Just leave it be.
Something has come close.
My case has tightened.
I can make out footsteps.

lines.zh: 这种时候我完全没防备
lines.en: I am defenceless at this stage.
I hope you are only passing by.
This leaf is trembling.
I pull tighter inside my case.
This is beyond me.
I will wait; there is nothing else.
Do not do this now.
I listen toward you.
You have not gone away.
Hanging in the wood, counting the sun.
The leaf muffles the sound.
My case feels hot.
I cannot even turn.
Do not touch my silk thread.

lines.zh: 我里面的东西也在紧张
lines.en: Something inside me is tense too.
A little longer and it will change.
Then things will be different.
All I can do is sway.
I bump my case against you.
Did that tickle?
I have no weapon at all.
Push again and we both fall.
The silk pulls me back.
I hit the leaf surface.
This hardly counts as an attack.
The chrysalis is not hard yet; wait for me.

lines.zh: 我不会一直是这个样子
lines.en: I will not always be like this.
I have taken shape beneath the leaf.
One thread holds me suspended.
The light outside shines through my case.

lines.zh: 茧里的翅膀，正一点点长硬。
lines.en: Inside the casing my wings slowly harden.
One more chrysalis in this area.

lines.zh: 我里面的形状刚刚定下
lines.en: My shape has only just settled.
The wind is stronger than before.
First the silk, then the case.

lines.zh: 我会在这里待一段日子
lines.en: I will be here for some days.
Do not take me for a dead leaf.
The leaf and my case curl in the heat.
I have fallen to the ground.
The rain has soaked us through.

lines.zh: 森林的叶子，被炸得乱飞。
lines.en: The blast sent forest leaves flying.
Something grazed my case.
That light whitens the inside of my case.

lines.zh: 我不用吃东西,但也撑不了太久
lines.en: I do not eat, but I cannot last forever.
The thunder presses me to the leaf.
I can't find a twig to hang from.
